title: Concentration Inequalities for Exchangeable Tensors and Matrix-valued Data
abstract: arXiv:2601.20152v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study concentration inequalities for structured weighted sums of random data, including (i) tensor inner products and (ii) sequential matrix sums. We are interested in tail bounds and concentration inequalities for those structured weighted sums under exchangeability, extending beyond the classical framework of independent terms.   We develop Hoeffding and Bernstein bounds provided with structure-dependent exchangeability. Along the way, we recover known results in weighted sum of exchangeable random variables and i.i.d. sums of random matrices to the optimal constants. We also derive a concentration bound for combinatorial sums of matrix arrays with an improved constant in the bias term compared with that by the method of exchangeable pairs.   For applications, the richer structures provide us with novel analytical tools for estimating the average effect of multi-factor response models and studying fixed-design sketching me

translated_title: 可交换张量与矩阵值数据的集中不等式
translated_abstract: 我们研究随机数据的结构化加权和的集中不等式，包括 张量内积以及 序贯矩阵和。我们关注在可交换性条件下这些结构化加权和的尾界与集中不等式，从而将研究范围拓展至超越经典独立项框架的情形。我们在结构相关的可交换性条件下建立了 Hoeffding 界和 Bernstein 界。在此过程中，我们以最优常数重新得到了关于可交换随机变量加权和以及独立同分布随机矩阵和的已知结果。我们还推导了矩阵阵列组合和的集中界，其偏差项中的常数相比可交换对方法有所改进。在应用方面，更丰富的结构为我们提供了新颖的分析工具，可用于估计多因子响应模型的平均效应以及研究固定设计草图方法。
tldr: 该论文在可交换性条件下为张量内积与序贯矩阵和等结构化加权和建立了 Hoeffding 与 Bernstein 型集中不等式，以最优常数恢复了已知结果并改进了矩阵组合和的偏差项常数，为多因子响应模型估计与固定设计草图方法提供了新的分析工具。
en_tdlr: This paper develops Hoeffding and Bernstein concentration inequalities for structured weighted sums such as tensor inner products and sequential matrix sums under exchangeability, recovering known results with optimal constants and improving bias-term constants for combinatorial matrix sums, with applications to multi-factor response models and fixed-design sketching.
